_doc: Blocks `git commit` if a security scan was not run during this session. Set BYPASS_SECURITY=1 to override (logged).

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'cmd="${TOOL_COMMAND:-}"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+commit"; then if [ "${BYPASS_SECURITY:-0}" = "1" ]; then echo "SECURITY_GATE: BYPASS_SECURITY=1 — commit allowed but logged." >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f .sylvain/.last-security-scan ] || [ $(($(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m .sylvain/.last-security-scan 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y .sylvain/.last-security-scan))) -gt 1800 ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Run /security-scan within the last 30 min before committing, or set BYPASS_SECURITY=1.\"}}"; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
